title: Birnbaum’s principles in Venn diagrams: Extended version with Lean verification
summary: We reformulate Birnbaum's theorem as a statement about classes of statistical procedures that preserve statistical relations, and show that the proof reduces to the propagation of evidential equality along chains of conditionality-related inference bases (experiment–observation pairs). For finite parameter spaces with at least two points, the sufficiency relation and the conditionality relation are incomparable, yet the corresponding preservation classes are nested.
